response.text: {"name":"Prerez domačije","idea":"The page is an architect's drawing sheet: on white drafting paper with a faint hairline grid, a single line-drawn elevation of a Prlekija gable house with its wine cellar below ground carries the whole site, because this atelje draws houses that keep the character of old homesteads and nothing is photographed yet.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#f3f2ef"},{"role":"text","hex":"#1c1a17"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#5f5a52"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#a8321e"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#f6efec"},{"role":"border","hex":"#d9d4cc"},{"role":"band","hex":"#1c1a17"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#ede8e1"}],"pairing":"fraunces-source-sans","typeCharacter":"Fraunces at weight 500 with its soft wedge serifs reads like a careful hand on tracing paper, warm but exact; the h1 is set at about 8vw in sentence case with tight leading, section headings at about 3.5vw, while Source Sans 3 at 18 to 20px carries all running text, lists and the steps in regular weight, with the muted tone for secondary lines.","composition":"Hero (white ground, 6 rows): the entire section carries a drafting grid of hairline rules in border colour every 48px, like squared tracing paper. Row 1 cols 1–3 the atelje name as a small wordmark in Fraunces, cols 10–12 the phone as text. Rows 2–4 cols 1–7 the h1 in two lines at about 8vw; row 5 cols 1–5 the lead; row 6 cols 1–3 the single red button Dogovorite prvi pogovor. Cols 7–12, rows 2–6: a line drawing in ink, one weight, of a long low gable house elevation seen from the front, with a horizontal ground line running across the columns and the rectangle of a vaulted cellar drawn below the ground line, the drawing bleeding off the right edge; two short dimension ticks sit above the roof ridge. Services (red primary field, full width, 4 rows): heading Kaj projektiram in onPrimary cols 1–5 at 3.5vw, its intro text cols 1–5 below; cols 7–12 a list of the eight offerings separated by hairline rules in onPrimary at 40 percent, each with its one-line description in smaller type. Story (white ground, 3 rows): heading Stara domačija ostane domačija cols 1–5; running text cols 7–12; under the heading in cols 1–4 a simple line drawing of a cellar arch, a half-circle on two posts, in ink. Steps (ink band, full width, 6 rows): heading Od prvega pogovora do gradnje in onBand cols 1–6 at 3.5vw; below it a vertical hairline rule down col 2 like a dimension line, and the six steps stacked in cols 3–10, each one a row with a hairline rule beneath: Prvi pogovor, brezplačen; Ogled parcele ali hiše na terenu; Idejna zasnova in 3D prikaz; Projektna dokumentacija DGD in PZI; Pridobitev gradbenega dovoljenja; Projektantski nadzor med gradnjo. Call (white ground, 4 rows): heading Načrtujete hišo ali prenovo? cols 1–6; lead cols 1–5; the phone as a large numeral at about 5vw cols 1–6 in red; email and the address Kerenčičev trg 5, 2270 Ormož in cols 1–4 below; cols 8–12 a schematic line map of Ormož with the square marked by a small filled red square. Footer strip in surface grey: name, Lina Bergant, univ. dipl. inž. arh., pooblastilo ZAPS, in a single line.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. All imagery is the layout system's line drawing in a single ink weight on the white ground: the hero elevation of a gable house with cellar below the ground line bleeding right, the small cellar arch in the story section, and the schematic map in the call section. The hero's hairline grid of rules is the only pattern. The red field and the ink band are flat colour with no texture.","signature":"A house that exists only as a drawing: the ink elevation of a gable house with its wine cellar drawn below a ground line, sitting on squared tracing paper beside the headline, so the visitor sees the architect's hand before anything else.","copy":{"headline":"Hiše in prenove, ki ohranijo značaj kraja","lead":"Projektiram enodružinske hiše, prenove starih domačij in vinskih kleti ter notranjo opremo. Prvi pogovor je brezplačen."},"imagePrompt":"A white first screen ruled with a faint hairline drafting grid; a two-line Fraunces headline at about 8vw fills the left seven columns above a short lead and one red button, while the right five columns hold a single-weight ink line drawing of a long gable house elevation with a vaulted cellar outlined below a horizontal ground line, bleeding off the right edge."}
